proposal.title: Reinstigate SWTH-rSWTH in TLA for now and decentralize TLA pool whitelisting
proposal.summary: Vote Yes on this proposal if you desire whitelisting and de-whitelisting Liquidity Alliance pools to be decided by collective governance rather than a single entity. And to reinstigate Carbon/Demex for now because it was removed without first passing a proposal. For full details, visit https://common.xyz/terra/discussion/26655-reinstigate-swthrswth-in-tla-and-decentralize-tla-pool-whitelisting
